explanation: The statement uses `placeOfEquation`, `heightOneSpectrumOfEquation` and a custom `IsFinitePlace` on the function field of a Weierstrass curve. All three are defined in this library. Mathlib has no `placeOfEquation` or `heightOneSpectrumOfEquation`. Its only `IsFinitePlace` is the number-field one in `Mathlib/NumberTheory/NumberField/Completion/FinitePlace.lean`, which is unrelated. The proof just unfolds the library's own definitions, so I found no Mathlib duplicate.
